prompt: Who can receive a shoe-rental refund?

options.text: A player who booked rental shoes before the first game
options.zh: 第一場比賽前就租鞋的選手

options.text: A player whose own shoes were damaged during practice and who rented shoes before the first game
options.zh: 練習時自備鞋損壞，在第一場正式比賽前租鞋的選手
options.whyZh: 自備鞋在正式比賽中損壞才符合退款條件，練習時損壞不算。

options.text: A player who changed shoe sizes before the tournament
options.zh: 賽前更換租鞋尺寸的選手
options.whyZh: 更換尺寸不是退費條件，開賽前的租鞋也不退費。

options.text: A player who rented centre shoes after damaging their own pair during a tournament game
options.zh: 自備球鞋在正式比賽中損壞後，改租球館球鞋的選手
options.whyZh: 這種因比賽中損壞而臨時租鞋才符合退款條件，講者也提醒保留收據。

evidence: The desk will refund the rental charge if your own shoes are damaged during a tournament game and you rent shoes from the centre. Shoes rented before your first tournament game, including rentals for practice, are not refundable.
explanationZh: 這種因比賽中損壞而臨時租鞋才符合退款條件，講者也提醒保留收據。
difficultyRationale: Separate normal pre-play rental from one during-game exception.

vocabulary.note: refundable 指符合特定條件可退費；光有收據不代表一定符合。
